anchors.0: No relevant evidence in the response
anchors.2: Partially addresses the question with gaps
anchors.3: Clear, relevant response with adequate support

dimensions.description: Addresses the question and role context.
Covers the important parts of the response.
Explains choices, trade-offs, and outcome where applicable.
Uses concrete examples without inventing candidate history.

overallCalculation: Weighted arithmetic mean; display both the 0-4 result and dimension breakdown.
guardrails: Do not infer personality, protected traits, or hiring suitability.
Do not treat an omitted example as proof the candidate lacks experience.
Example answers are illustrative coaching aids, never attributed to the candidate.
